findings.evidence: Lines 286-299: the only consumers of hP are `hP.q_orthogonal_e₁`, `hP.pT_orthogonal_e₁`, `hP.e₁_orthogonal_e₂` (line 290) and `hP.uniquenessAssumptions hSymm hQ2 hTT` (line 298), whose own signature at line 222 takes `hP : SpectatorPair g K`; the only consumer of hA/hA0 is `mul_right_cancel₀ (hA.apply_e₁_e₂_ne_zero hSymm hP hA0)` at line 292.
findings.fix: State it as `(hP : SpectatorPair g K) (hTT : …) (hA₁₂ : A hP.e₁ hP.e₂ ≠ 0)`, dropping `hA` and `hA0`; callers with a plane pass `hP.toSpectatorPair` and `hA.apply_e₁_e₂_ne_zero hSymm hP hA0` (as `existsUnique_eq_fromF1F2_add_smul`, line 313, already has to hand).
findings.issue: `fromF1F2_add_smul_injective` assumes `hP : SpectatorPlane` and `hA : ParityOddAssumptions g K A` with `hA0 : A ≠ 0`, but the proof uses the `span` field nowhere and uses `hA`/`hA0` only at line 292 to produce `A hP.e₁ hP.e₂ ≠ 0`. Linear independence of the three structures needs neither four-dimensionality nor that A is covariant/conserved/alternating.

findings.evidence: `hnorm` is consumed only through `hP.exists_quarter_turn hSymm hnorm` (line 154), which needs literal equality of norms; the statements at lines 260, 310 and 324 refer only to `fromF1F2 g K F1 F2 + c • A`, so rescaling `e₂` leaves the conclusion unchanged, and `SpectatorPlane.span` (Basic.lean:1161) survives the rescaling with `c₂` replaced by `c₂ / t`.
findings.fix: Add a `SpectatorPlane.normalize` (rescaling `e₂`) and state `exists_eq_fromF1F2_add_smul`, `existsUnique_eq_fromF1F2_add_smul` and `exists_eq_fromF1F2_add_smul_iff` with `0 < g hP.e₁ hP.e₁ * g hP.e₂ hP.e₂` instead; keep `hnorm` where it is genuinely used, in `exists_quarter_turn` and `apply_eq_of_spectatorPair`.
findings.issue: `hnorm : g hP.e₁ hP.e₁ = g hP.e₂ hP.e₂` in the four public theorems (lines 256, 306, 320, and `eq_of_apply_eq` line 168) is stronger than the result needs. The conclusions never mention `e₂`, and any spectator plane whose two directions have norms of the same sign gives an equal-norm plane by rescaling `e₂` to `t • e₂` with `t = √(g e₁ e₁ / g e₂ e₂)`, which preserves every `SpectatorPlane` field including `span`. A user with an orthogonal but unnormalized spacelike spectator basis cannot apply the theorem as stated.

summary: The main theorems sit at the right level (proper covariance rather than the roadmap's full IsLorentzCovariant, no symmetry on W), but two hypothesis bundles are stronger than the proofs use: fromF1F2_add_smul_injective assumes a SpectatorPlane plus full ParityOddAssumptions where only a SpectatorPair and `A e₁ e₂ ≠ 0` are used, and the equal-norm hypothesis can be weakened to equal sign by rescaling e₂.
